resolution.note: Delivered by GLOBAL #475 (merge 58c46090, main CI 40849664528 SUCCESS): CI resolves the change-contract range from the merge base.

title: Resolve contract ranges from the merge base in CI and ship
body:
GLOBAL npm run changes:check resolves its range from git merge-base, while the CI step passes the raw pull_request.base.sha (.github/workflows/validate.yml) and krn ship checks the merge commit. On #474 the local check passed and CI failed with unreadable-range because main had moved past the branch base; it cost a merge commit and a third panel.
Acceptance: changes:check, the CI change-contract step and krn ship use one range resolver based on the merge base of the PR base and head; a branch whose base is an ancestor of main but not equal to it passes when its contracts hold; the CI workflow observer pins the new behavior RED on base and GREEN on head.
